CustomField.description: The run status change this event reports: Started, Waiting, Paused, Resumed, Rescued, Succeeded, Failed, Cancelled, Reconciled, CancellationRequested, or ApprovalReassigned. Steps that keep the run Running, such as a tool call, publish no event; they are Agent Events on the run.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Read-only. Filter on this value in a Flow, for example Succeeded to start the next agent. Re-read the run before acting, because events are hints.
CustomField.label: Transition
